name: unified_analytics_kit
tagline: One API that sends events to Firebase, Facebook and your own backend.
summary: A Flutter analytics toolkit that sends events to Firebase, Facebook App Events and your own backend through one API — with a persistent device ID, an offline queue and per-provider user consent.

features.d: logEvent reaches Firebase, Facebook and your own backend.
Denied by default and tracked per provider.
Survives reinstall where the OS allows it.
Hive-backed batching, retry, backoff and Retry-After support.
One failing provider never affects the others.
Names and parameters follow Firebase and Facebook rules.

steps.d: Add it from GitHub and pin a tag so updates never break your app.
steps.code:
dependencies:
  unified_analytics_kit:
    git:
      url: https://github.com/psbmlabs/unified_analytics_kit.git
      ref: v0.0.1

steps.d: Call it once at startup, then log events anywhere.

sections.title: Choose where data goes
sections.text: An event reaches a provider only when it is enabled in config, the user granted consent, and the call allows that destination. Priority: call → screen → app default.

sections.title: Simple JSON contract
sections.text: The database provider POSTs batches with device_id, device info and events[] (each with a UUID id so you can ignore duplicates). 2xx removes events; 400/413/422 drops the batch; 429/5xx/timeouts retry with backoff (5 s → 5 min).
sections.note: The apiKey ships inside your app, so it is not a secret. Validate payloads and rate-limit on your server.

config.title: Key options
rows: Failures before pausing until next launch

lists.title: Privacy & store policies
items: Declare device-ID collection in the Google Play Data safety form.
Publish a privacy policy covering Firebase, Facebook and your backend.
On iOS, show the App Tracking Transparency prompt before enabling Facebook.
Never pass emails or phone numbers as user IDs or parameters.

lists.title: Known limitations
items: Firebase assigns its own event time; timestamp is kept only in your database.
Logging out offline uploads queued events later without user_id.
iOS cannot guarantee device-ID persistence after uninstall.

cta: Need analytics wired into your app?
We integrate, test and ship it for you — Firebase, Facebook and custom backends.
